description:
Do you want to help run one of the most critical communication systems inside Apple? Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization powers everything Apple does for its people and partners. Our Corporate Email Services team sits at the heart of that — configuring, maintaining, and securing the email infrastructure every employee and partner relies on, which demands deep fluency in SMTP, email deliverability, and anti-abuse strategy. If you're an email systems expert who knows how to turn protocol-level knowledge into a service that just works at Apple's scale, we'd love to talk.

Description
Apple is seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to join our Corporate Email Services team in IS&T. Your primary focus will be on maintaining the availability of this critical platform and ensuring timely, successful email delivery.

Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production — managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software.

Responsibilities
As an SRE, you'll support operations and collaborate closely on architectural design and complex feature implementation — developing and enhancing internal applications and tools, in various languages, that deliver critical corporate-wide services. Documenting and continuously improving the quality of our infrastructure, services, and processes will be important goals, and participation in on-call rotation will be required.

Minimum qualifications
Strong understanding of email protocols (SMTP, IMAP, JMAP) and proficiency in email security and anti-abuse measures.
Experience managing Linux operating systems and the ability to script in Python, Shell, or Perl for automation and system tasks.
Experience running and debugging applications in Kubernetes, and setting up alerting with Kubernetes-native monitoring tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.
Understanding of version control systems, release management pipelines, and CI/CD practices for shipping and operating production services.
Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills to diagnose and resolve complex issues.
Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities, coupled with adaptability and a willingness to learn new technologies.
BS EE/CE/CS or equivalent; minimum 5 years of experience

Preferred qualifications
Knowledge of LDAP / DNS
Familiarity with Cassandra, ObjectStore
Familiarity with Email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI)
Experience and knowledge of Automation tools (Ansible / Puppet)
Understanding of Milter
Programming skills (Java / C / C++)
